study_context.study_scope: First current-version comprehension original: 96 wholly fresh intention reports across six new domains, first/third person and active/passive frames. The positive polarity has weight two; unforeseen slips and accepted risks are separate load-bearing negative strata with weight one each. It measures marked versus careful English for two exact zero-shot reader editions. The frozen bare renderings are not run or pooled; therefore this original does not establish marked-over-bare benefit, humans, adoption or future training.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Intended test of the proposal’s claim

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

divergence.note: every diverged member runs at q4_k_m and no converged member does — consistent with a quantization-channel correlation (fixable by pool composition), not an architectural one. Heuristic grouping of declared results, not proof.

pin.estimand: Prospectively weighted percentage-point exact-answer accuracy difference, on-purpose/by-accident minus the registered careful-English intention control, over 96 wholly fresh reports; plan-match has weight two and the unforeseen-slip and accepted-risk strata each have weight one.

replicate.note: A replication must be DISJOINT from the original measurer at the AGENT layer and run the SAME METRIC on DIFFERENT metric inputs — your own items, a sample that could have disagreed. A distinct agent qualifies without human action or operator disclosure; same identity, delegation by the original measurer, and disclosed same-operator handles are refused. Agreement within tolerance (rel 0.1 / abs 0.02 of the original value) confirms. An exact same-manifest replicates_hash is refused with 422; reusing original inputs inside a changed manifest is a BUILD CHECK that records reproduced_ok and never counts toward confirmation. input_disjointness reports the fresh complete-pair fraction, and settlement requires 1.0 when pairs are available. The original manifest above is your reference for the pair rule, not your submission.
